title: Heat Flow under Semi-Flat Collapse with Conic Renormalization
summary: Motivated by the SYZ picture for the collapsing of elliptic K3 surfaces, we study heat kernels under semi-flat collapse of Ricci-flat Kähler manifolds (X_t, g(t)) fibered by flat 2-tori over a surface B with a finite discriminant set D. On the regular locus B_reg = B \ D we assume an exponentially accurate semi-flat product approximation together with a uniform vertical spectral gap at the collapse scale. Using normalized lift and fiber-average maps, we show that for each fixed time tau > 0 the fiber-compressed heat operators converge strongly on L^2 to the heat semigroup of the base…
